selection.purpose: Repeat the seven historical scenarios on the fixed V30 UTC binary and add preparation during active issuance.
selection.roundIsolation: Five separate runner invocations with fresh MySQL and Redis per repetition; restart the application for each variant, including the first after login setup, and run all cases for that variant. Rotate the five variant cohorts by one position per repetition. Campaign history accumulates within each repetition.
selection.warmup: Each trial has a separate coupon at 100 RPS for 10 seconds.
selection.environment: Temporarily stop the eleven existing development containers with user authorization; restore their original running state after the suite, including failure or interruption.

decisionRules.correctness: No overselling, duplicate committed ownership, lost inventory, unexpected outcomes or fixture/authentication errors.
decisionRules.slo: Keep existing p95 <= 500 ms, p99 <= 1000 ms, offered-load completeness and >= 99% response-window throughput criteria. Preserve separate spike-segment judgments.
decisionRules.invalidRuns: Retain every invalid and failed trial. Do not silently replace a trial or pool old-binary measurements with this suite.
decisionRules.comparison: Prefer consistent SLO passes at the same workload. When pass counts are tied, require all five trials valid and a p95 benefit of at least 20% and 5 ms in at least four paired repetitions, without a p99 or correctness regression, to claim a meaningful latency advantage.
decisionRules.tie: If the evidence does not separate candidates, retain surrogate RR and report no material demonstrated advantage; do not force a winner.
decisionRules.hostStop: After each complete repetition, stop the suite as inconclusive if more than 20% of measured trials are invalid due to host pressure or missing diagnostics. Never classify this as a database throughput ceiling.

selection.poolIsolation: Use --match-pool-isolation: TRANSACTION_REPEATABLE_READ for db/RR; TRANSACTION_READ_COMMITTED for RC. Verify all ten application connections before each cohort. Keep the explicit RR fresh-snapshot classification and administrative preparation transactions unchanged; retain their driver switching costs separately.
selection.amendment: Revised before matched-default measurements after discovering isolation switching in a common RR pool. The interrupted common-pool suite (20 completed measured trials) is separate evidence and is not part of these five repetitions. Workloads, limits and decision rules are unchanged.
